challenge.method: Compared the incremental example with the §4 alternation production, the verified elements and rulelist errata, and the RFC 7405 update.
challenge.results: The two verified errata address whitespace at grammar boundaries. They leave the published alternative and incremental-alternative examples directly supportive. Later terminal-string changes address a separate feature.

limitations: This finding concerns ordinary and incremental alternatives in RFC 5234. It makes no portability or parser-conformance assertion.
